title: San Choy Bow

extendedIngredients.name: iceberg lettuce
extendedIngredients.original: 1 iceberg lettuce, leaves separated into cups

extendedIngredients.name: water chestnuts
extendedIngredients.original: 225 g can water chestnuts, drained and roughly chopped

extendedIngredients.name: gluten free oyster sauce
extendedIngredients.original: 2 tbsp (40 ml) gluten free oyster sauce

steps: Stir the tamari, gluten free oyster sauce and brown sugar together in a small bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Trim the base off the iceberg lettuce, separate the leaves into cups, rinse and drain well, then chill until serving.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the pork mince and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up into small pieces with your spoon, until browned all over.
Pour in the sauce and toss for 2 minutes so the mince is glossy and well coated.
Stir in the water chestnuts and carrot and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, keeping their crunch. Take off the heat and stir through the sesame oil and most of the spring onions.
Spoon the mince into the lettuce cups at the table, scatter with the peanuts and remaining spring onion, and eat straight away while the lettuce is crisp.
